mmproj._note: Mandatory: without the projector the model sees no image.

launch.name: flash-attn
launch.description: Flash attention kernels; required for the vision stack.

launch.name: jinja
launch.description: Use the chat template from the GGUF metadata; the transcription mode is the empty prompt and grounding is a bare word.

launch.name: reasoning-budget
launch.description: Budget for thinking tokens; the model is trained with thinking disabled, the chat template default.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Sampling randomness; 0.1 is the official LightOnOCR client's setting for v3 "use temperature 0.1, not greedy decoding"; the card's example: 0.2 with top_p 0.9.

request.name: top_p
request.description: Nucleus sampling cutoff; the model card's recommended setting.

request.name: repeat_penalty
request.description: Penalty for repeating tokens; 1.0 disables it.

request.name: presence_penalty
request.description: Penalty for tokens already present in the prompt; 0 disables it.

request.name: frequency_penalty
request.description: Penalty proportional to token frequency; 0 disables it.

request.name: stream
request.description: Stream tokens as they arrive; false gives the parser one complete response.

request.name: cache_prompt
request.description: Reuse the prompt cache; false avoids the recurring-state position warnings Qwen3.5 logs when requests share a prefix.
